answer: To bridge identities across epochs, the vault issues a unique opal token tied to the bond, so a single agent cannot mint many voting identities without locking separate collateral. Sybil resistance can work through a staked identity vault: each agent locks a bond before joining, and every attestation it gives is weighted by that bond. Attacker costs scale linearly with fake identities, since each requires fresh capital at risk of slashing. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
